shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure carved in low relief on a large upright stone slab/monolith
frontal/upright standing posture filling the surface
circular disc or medallion motif on the body
justification: Both surfaces depict a single large anthropomorphic figure occupying the entire face of an upright slab, wearing an elaborate headdress, with a prominent disc/medallion on the torso and curvilinear incised motifs plus rectilinear glyph-like blocks. The differences are substantial in specifics: A is a massive, near-sculptural blocky figure with a broad squared head, minimal limbs and abstract body markings, while B is a flat, fully drawn profile-legged standing figure with defined arms, feet, held objects and a column of discrete sign blocks beside it.
